page.notes: The first lines are in bold italic type and partly damaged; readings such as "pænitentiam", "pacisci" and "profiteantur" are uncertain. The page number is read as 667. The catchword at the bottom right is partly illegible and given as "ibe-" with uncertainty. Some names in the subscription list are blurred and may be misread.
